description: Specialized TEAM and SKILL pack for the content-creator career: improvised production craft (lighting, audio, framing, shooting and editing with what's on hand), career-skill systems for refining the craft (content pillars, hooks, repurposing, analytics, brand deals, audience building), and team-play entries for how creator teams and collaborators coordinate shoots, improvise crews, hand off work, and protect each other from burnout. Builds toward personal refinement tools: sustainable cadence, voice protection, and honest metrics. Every entry leads with mechanism diagnosis, then improvisation, steps, and explicit stop conditions.

track_emphasis.build: secondary — pillar systems, product studio, cadence/buffer, pipeline, style bible
track_emphasis.create: secondary — hook bank, series formats, thumbnails/titles, audience persona, collab design
track_emphasis.improve: primary — retention, analytics, delivery training, negotiation, team rituals, handoffs, burnout protocol
track_emphasis.restore: tertiary — audio salvage, channel recovery, burnout recovery
track_emphasis.combine: secondary — repurposing pipeline, cross-platform pipeline, two-person shooter+talent roles
track_emphasis.improvise: primary — Sidewinder doctrine core: household-light rigs, earbud mics, phone-stack tripods, volunteer crews, gear sharing

safety_posture: Lawful creator work only. Physical safety stops throughout: no hot-bulb fabric diffusion, no unsafe night locations, no filming without consent or against venue rules. Burnout entries carry explicit health stops: breakdown-stage signs route to professional help, not to course protocol. Brand-deal entries require written terms; no handshake usage-rights deals.
